vibe_rationale: Long-running yoga community gathering, but an expo-and-classes format with a brand showcase that leans commercial and is thin on subculture.
fit_notes: The most direct wellness audience found in Japan, with health-adjacent brands already exhibiting (Pocari Sweat, Oisix, super.natural) and a 2026 sleep theme that suits a health brand. An exhibitor page is published, so the route is open at expo-style cost. The 10,000 figure is an organiser projection.
